thread:
acme_ops: Hey team — our dashboard for streaming tokens/sec just flipped to negative around 09:12 UTC and a bunch of windows are missing. Customers are seeing spikes in latency too. This started after you rolled analytics yesterday?

kevin_support: Sorry about that, we're on it. Can you paste a sample request id or route that's showing the negative tokens/sec?

acme_ops: route=generate_text, example request_id=req_2023-10-18T09:11:33Z_abc123. Console shows tokens/sec -1200 for a ~1m window, then gaps.

kevin_support: thx. tagging SRE: @sara_sre and analytics: @alex_analytics. monitor-bot, do you have alerts? :eyes:

monitor-bot: Alert: streaming.token_rate anomaly detected for route=generate_text. Metric source: streaming-aggregator-prod. First breach at 1697640753.

sara_sre: Looking at the consumer lag for metrics topic. kafka-consumer-groups shows a rebalance at 09:08 and one partition had an offset rollback of ~150k. Possible out-of-order ingestion.

alex_analytics: I pulled the raw counter series from clickhouse:

```
SELECT ts, route, counter_total
FROM streaming_counters
WHERE route = 'generate_text' AND ts BETWEEN toDateTime(1697640600) AND toDateTime(1697641200)
ORDER BY ts
```

There are a few points where counter_total goes from ~1.2e6 down to 300k which makes the delta negative and our rate calc (difference / window) produces negative tokens/sec.

josh_eng: That sounds like a counter reset/replay rather than a bug in the math. Possible causes: aggregator restart that reset local counters, or kafka replay wrote older messages with lower counters. Any recent deploys to streaming-aggregator?

kevin_support: We did deploy a small change to the aggregator yesterday to improve batching behavior (PR #3456). Was a config change rolled too?

sara_sre: Confirmed: deploy at 08:59 with a config flip to enable faster flush. At 09:07 one of the aggregator instances crashed and restarted; consumer group rebalanced and leader reassigned. During restart we saw old offsets replayed on partition 3.

alex_analytics: Our rate computation assumes monotonic counters and simply does delta = current - prev. When delta < 0 we currently annotate but still surface the negative value in the dashboard. That leads to negative tokens/sec and chart inversion.

kevin_support: Two problem vectors: 1) dashboard showing negative values (misleading) 2) missing windows where aggregator lost a chunk of ingested samples. Customers see latency spikes because the dashboard TTL triggers downstream scaling? (maybe an alert).

sara_sre: Immediate mitigation: clamp negative deltas to 0 in the streaming-agg transform so dashboards don't show negative rates. Also reprocess the affected offsets to backfill missing windows. Plan: rollback the config flip on aggregator to stop restarts, and run a controlled replay from offset 1,230,000 to 1,400,000 on topic metrics-raw for the affected partition.

josh_eng: I can cut a hotfix now — PR #3499 will add a defensive clamp:

```
// in rate_calculator.go
delta := curr - prev
if delta < 0 {
  // counter reset or replay; treat as reset
  delta = 0
  log.Info("clamped negative delta", "route", route, "ts", ts)
}
rate := delta / windowSeconds
```

kevin_support: Good. Also add a tag so we can filter clamped events in the dashboard for audit.

alex_analytics: For backfill I'm going to run a reprocessing job that reads raw events and repopulates the aggregate table for 09:05-09:15. Repro steps for us to validate: 1) run kafka-replay --topic metrics-raw --from-offset 1230000 --to-offset 1400000 --dry-run 2) check clickhouse target table for monotonic counter progression 3) run hourly agg job to rebuild tokens/sec windows.

acme_ops: Any ETA? Customers are complaining about billing UI showing weird spikes and the support queue is filling.

kevin_support: Hotfix deploy in ~15m (PR #3499). Reprocessing will take ~45m after that. We'll keep you posted here. Apologies for the disruption. :pray:

monitor-bot: Deploy CI passed for PR #3499. Canary results: 30m no regressions on canary cluster.

sara_sre: Rolling rollback of the config flip started (rolling restart) to reduce chance of further offset regressions. Also notified infra to pin consumer group commit behavior.

josh_eng: Hotfix deployed to production at 09:34 UTC. Clamping landed. I verified the dashboard no longer shows negatives for the sample route; values clamp to 0 where counter resets happened.

alex_analytics: Backfill job started 09:40 UTC (job id backfill-20231018-01). Estimated finish 10:20 UTC. After backfill we'll validate total token counts vs billing ledger.

kevin_support: Created INC-4821 and linked the customer ticket. Noting action items:
- rollback risky config (done)
- hotfix to clamp negatives (done)
- run backfill and validate with billing (in progress)
- add metric to monitoring for counter resets per partition (todo)

acme_ops: Thanks. Please DM me when billing ledger validated.

kevin_support: Will do. If you see any other routes with odd numbers pls ping here.

sara_sre: Postmortem to follow once backfill & billing validation are complete. Preliminary root cause: aggregator config change + instance restart led to kafka offset replay that produced decreasing raw counters; analytics pipeline didn't handle counter resets robustly.

acme_ops: Appreciate the quick action. :+1:
